_note: Ceilings for flint-ONLY pjdfstest failures, differenced against a knfsd control on the same rig. Two numbers because the server has two postures: FLINT_NFS_ENFORCE_PERMISSIONS defaults to warn, under which permission checks are evaluated and logged but never enforced — so the default-mode count is the pre-fix one BY DESIGN, not a regression.

_enforcing_breakdown._comment: Authorization was 265 of 646 before the checks landed and is 4 now. What remains is dominated by CREATE(SOCK|FIFO|BLK|CHR) being a regular-file STAND-IN — a deliberate choice (mknod needs root and a CSI export must not let callers dereference host devices) — and by a separate pre-existing bug returning EIO on paths near PATH_MAX. Neither is an authorization gap; do not read the total as one.
